# Issue #87 — Architect's post-Arm publication-state satisfaction adjudication v0.3.0

**Subject:** `GA-PUBLICATION-STATE-SATISFACTION-ADJUDICATION-v0.3.0`  
**Status:** `PROPOSED / ARCHITECT-SELECTED / LOCKED UNTIL RATIFIED`. This is NOT an accepted ADR/NIB, executable transition, evidence of successful Git I/O, Git DC qualification, formal checker proof, completion of two-provider hostile review, or GREEN authorization.  
**Frozen source baseline:** `fanilosendrison/turnlock-rust@ec52ebc62d4d9584e16c7e6bbb26ccb4f466135d`.  
**Accepted upstream authority:** [ADR-057 — runner ready as observation-bound publication](https://github.com/fanilosendrison/turnlock-rust/blob/ec52ebc62d4d9584e16c7e6bbb26ccb4f466135d/docs/adr/adr-057-define-gate-a-runner-ready-as-observation-bound-publication.md).  
**Candidate Git occurrence producer:** [#91 qualified observation v0.2.0](https://github.com/fanilosendrison/turnlock-rust/issues/91#issuecomment-6267500720), NOT yet accepted or conformant.  
**Predecessor:** [#87 v0.2.0](https://github.com/fanilosendrison/turnlock-rust/issues/87#issuecomment-6261289248), still unaccepted. This comment replaces its *candidate* architectural selection; it does not rewrite that frozen historical text.  
**Owning dependencies:** #87 M2/M8 progression; #88 target/effective writer; #89 separately governed pre-Arm freshness; #90 M0/M1/M2/M7/M8 coherence; #91 actual Git DC; #32 NIB-T; #33 complete construction review. Issue #78 retains other open responsibilities. No Issue/Project state or repository source is modified by this comment.

## 1. Adjudicated proposition: progress safety is distinct from Execution truth

For one applicable `PublicationIntent I`, co-admitted publication `Obligation O`, `WorkItem W`, exact target ref `R`, strict fast-forward `P ≺ T`, and exact qualified CandidateRevision `C`:

```text
HistoricalExecutionOutcome(E)
    !=
ExternalRefStateObserved(I,T)
    !=
ResidualEffectsClosedForProgression(I)
    !=
M2PublicationObligationSatisfied(I)
```

ADR-057 explicitly permits actor-neutral **state-oriented** publication completion, but does not permit post-Arm shortcuts without a separate positively proven safe-effect closure. A valid observation of `R=T` is not historical `PROVEN-COMPLETED(E)`, `PROVEN-NOT-EXECUTED(E)`, `not-applied` or `ExecutionProgressionSupersessionRef`.

**Selected candidate rule:** a single positive, exhaustive, I-scoped publication progression closure may remove the *need* to resolve E's historical outcome before I progresses, while preserving the historical outcome facts and M8 classifications unchanged. M8 remains the sole historical uncertainty classifier. No second classifier of E is created.

Only an independent, positively qualified M7-B/Git-DC proof and a single lawful M2 atomic admission can change I's progression status. The absence of that proof leaves all normal M8/recovery/operator gates intact.

## 2. Scope and residual-effect theorem

The initial selected lane is confined to:
1. An exact currently applicable `I` on one consumer-authoritative protected Git branch `R`, with `P ≠ T` and independent positive proof that `P` is a **strict ancestor** of exact intended commit `T`.
2. At least one historically Armed E for `W(I)` whose relevant historical publication outcome remains epistemically unknown (including legitimate M8 `UNRESOLVABLE` or operator-superseded E). Cases with no such E remain with existing direct/new-intent/already-current routes.
3. Every still-potentially-effectful Armed E covered by the closure is independently proven to have **only** the exact relevant atomic, conditional expected-old ref mutation `CAS(R,P,T)`, with no fallback, hidden replay, alternate ref, force-like bypass or other effect that can invalidate the published-state assertion. Any relevant additional effect must be positively bounded and rendered inert before admission.
4. One positive *actual, qualified* remote observation point `t_obs` establishing `R(t_obs)=T`, from the accepted #91 trusted Git I/O producer profile, exact #88 authority binding and accepted provider consistency profile.
5. The effective ordinary-writer enforcement/environmental contract ensures every subsequent accepted update to this **still-designated authoritative R**, within the declared threat model and relevant future-effect interval, preserves its previous tip as ancestor-or-equal and forbids deletion. Under that assumption, no later accepted state can be strict ancestor P, so each old `CAS(R,P,T)` becomes permanently unable to mutate R.

**Proof claim only:** `∀ E in K_unknown: no future R mutation by the modeled old E publication operation after t_obs`. This is NOT physical termination of E, historical authorship of the update, current `R=T` at M2 commit, an all-external-effects theorem, perpetual-proof-from-a-single-ruleset-GET, or immunity to admin/protection bypass and provider compromise (excluded by the pinned proto-ring ARM threat model). If effect scope, transport CAS, target/principal, external monotonicity or actual read consistency are not qualified, return `NOT_ESTABLISHED` and NEVER admit the closure.

The Git DC is currently absent. No existing experiment qualifies a production GitHub read or atomic guarded CAS. This is an explicit external dependency, not a theorem already established by this proposal.

## 3. Exact M2 coherent history projection — NEVER `unresolvedExecutions` alone

Candidate read-only `LoadPublicationEffectHistoryViewV1` reconstructs **in ONE M2 SQLite read transaction** the exact (run, StateRevision `r`, ownership generation `g`, current I/W/O/C/qualification, exact R/P/T), all previous intents in its authoritative replacement chain, all W(I) historical Executions ordered by `attemptOrdinal` (strictly increasing and unambiguous), their creation bases, Arm and immutable operation/recovery-capability bindings, direct admitted outcomes, recovered terminal truth, pending evidence, operator progression supersessions, nonapplication facts, all recovery and producer blockers with dispositions, and original immutable evidence refs.

The returned versioned historical projection must include every authorized **unarmed** E as well as every Armed E. It may be derived read-only from M2 tables but NOT from separate per-E snapshots taken at different revisions. Its exact canonical serialization and `effectHistoryDigest` are M0-owned versioned construction details; the final admission must compare the COMPLETE verified projection and authoritative current facts, not trust a supplied digest alone.

Independently confirm that each prior applicable intent for R already satisfied the accepted prior-intent effect-safety rules, or has its own valid positive closure that is still sufficient for the relevant future-effect interval. The new pathway never legalizes an unsafe prior-intent replacement retrospectively. Any contradicting chain, cross-ref binding, missing Arm fact or skipped Execution makes the proposal `INVALID_MUTATION` or `INTEGRITY_FAILURE` according to the owning M2 contract.

For every E in W(I), derive EXACTLY one category from authoritative facts:

| Category | Exact handling |
|---|---|
| `UNARMED` | Historical authorized E, no permitted ref effect yet; retain E and fence any future Arm when O is atomically satisfied. |
| `POSITIVELY_NON_EFFECTFUL` | Exact authoritative `PROVEN-NOT-EXECUTED`, or exact valid direct `PublicationNonApplicationRef`. Retain the existing truth/provenance; don't reinterpret it as a completion of I. |
| `ARMED_EFFECT_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN` | Arm exists, historical effect remains unknown. Includes possibly-dispatched, pending-policy-exhausted, progression-superseded E, and valid terminal M8 `UNRESOLVABLE`. Every such E must be included in K and receive a positive effect-scope/guard proof. |
| `POSITIVE_KNOWN_APPLIED_OR_OTHER_TERMINAL` | Known direct applied result or independently recovered terminal result/known technical failure not positively shown non-applying. Preserve its normal exact qualification/recovery route; it may NOT be relabeled as unknown for this lane. Reject state-lane admission where its required ordinary qualification/disposition remains conflicting or incomplete. |
| `INCONSISTENT_OR_UNSUPPORTED` | Incoherent attempt history, wrong target, missing proof, or invalid recovery state => fail closed. |

**Important mixed-history correction to v0.2.0:** `E1` may be superseded/unknown while `E2` has an authoritative direct `not-applied` result and a corresponding `PublicationNonApplicationRef`. `E2` stays positively non-applying; the unknown E1 remains in K. If R=T and all E1 effects are proved inert, the I-scoped state lane MAY be eligible; it must not erase, reclassify or relabel E2's direct result. A blanket ban on *any* direct result would incorrectly deadlock this case. Conversely, where there is only an ordinary direct `not-applied` E and **no unknown Armed E**, the existing NIB-S §30 route may prepare a new `I2 = T→T` after a fresh valid observation under normal safe intent-replacement rules. There is no post-Arm already-current shortcut for the original W(I).

A claimed `UNRESOLVABLE` must have been lawfully and positively established by M8 under the **then-applicable accepted** recovery/domain contract. In particular, the currently open M7-B `missing/X -> unknown` issue cannot be silently treated as a valid positive `RecoveryIndeterminacyRef` merely because a historical operation query was unsupported. Integrity-invalid recovery is never rehabilitated by an independent later R=T observation. Current selected M7-B requires a non-null RecoveryCapability for an Armed publication E; `no-recovery-capability` for that exact profile is therefore not a normal eligibility case. A separately accepted future profile might permit a lawful case and must qualify it explicitly.

## 4. One new I-scoped fact; no invented per-E outcome, no WorkItem success

Choose exactly one new candidate authoritative fact:

```ts
interface PublicationProgressionClosureRefV1 {
  readonly schema: "gate-a-publication-progression-closure.v1";
  readonly closureId: string; // deriveId("publication-progression-closure.v1", I.id)
  readonly runId: GateARunId;
  readonly publicationIntentId: PublicationIntentId;
  readonly publicationWorkItemId: WorkItemId;
  readonly publicationObligationId: ObligationId;
  readonly candidateId: CandidateRevisionId;
  readonly qualificationId: GateAQualificationId;
  readonly transition: AuthorizedGitTransitionRef;
  readonly qualifiedObservation: ArtifactRef;  // exact #91 witness
  readonly effectHistoryProjection: ArtifactRef; // full K and positive safe/unknown statuses
  readonly residualEffectProof: ArtifactRef;     // exact per-E guards + scope + ARM
}
```

The versioned full history projection and effect proof must recompute, be duplicate-free, strictly ordered by historical attempt identity, contain exact Arm operation/dispatch/capability and blocker bindings, and cover all E in K. K may include multiple old superseded E; it is NEVER derived from the active recovery list only. The exact eventual M0 serialization, hash framing and accepted `closureId` type are required NIB closure work, not freedom for implementation agents.

The sole closure ID is a logical single-assignment identifier **per PublicationIntent**. Unadmitted candidate artifacts (including crash orphans) do NOT reserve that ID. First successfully admitted exact candidate owns it; after admission, a duplicate cannot create a new revision and different bytes under the same logical ID are incompatible. No new `ExecutionRef`, `PROVEN-COMPLETED`, `PROVEN-NOT-EXECUTED`, `UNRESOLVABLE`, `PublicationNonApplicationRef` or operator-successor supersession is manufactured.

**WorkItem separation:** a publication WorkItem W is NOT declared `satisfied` unless its own required qualified result class exists under NIB-S §8.5. The independent state proof instead satisfies its exact sole source Obligation O, making W **inert for scheduling and future Arm** under existing source-obligation guards. This is consistent with the currently admitted pre-Arm already-current path, which creates the W/O bundle but no Execution. No new `WorkItemSatisfied` artifact or synthetic result class is selected.

## 5. Occurrence proof consumes the #91 contract, with NO durable #87 observation Q

Consume exactly the candidate [QualifiedRemoteRefObservationV1 contract](https://github.com/fanilosendrison/turnlock-rust/issues/91#issuecomment-6267500720): context `(run,r,g,I,W,O)`, exact target, existing `GateAPublicationTargetObservationV1` value, actual trusted Git DC read receipt, approved producer/authoritative-target/reader-capability/provider-consistency qualifications and actual **post-context** observation occurrence. At remote ref level, the read returns a Git OID; exact tree SHA must be checked against the trusted retained commit object/projection, not attributed to the transport's ref reply.

The prospective first M2 admission must also receive a valid **live, non-serializable, protected, one-shot producer-admission capability** bound to the exact M2 read context and real I/O invocation, controlled under #91/#90. Arbitrary user-supplied JSON/ArtifactRef, including an otherwise correct copied receipt or nonce, is insufficient. The selected dependency adapter is explicitly in the I/O-fact trusted computing base. The candidate does not assert independent cryptographic proof against a lying adapter.

There is NO candidate `BeginPublicationStateObservationAttempt(Q)` M2 mutation, separate Q StateRevision, Q consumption, Q supersession, or crash-reuse of a pre-admission receipt for #87. If the process fails before M2 closure, the live capability is lost; a new read context and new actual READ-ONLY remote observation are required on resumption. Identical observation value bytes across two real reads are legal; a repeated value artifact does not impersonate a repeated occurrence.

**#89 is independent.** This comment neither removes nor accepts its distinct pre-Arm Q proposal and does not waive pre-Arm Arm revalidation. Existing #89 remains OPEN.

## 6. M8 historical classification and new blocker-disposition law

Retain M8-A recovery observation, finite pending classification, exact `PROVEN-NOT-EXECUTED`, `PROVEN-COMPLETED`, and `UNRESOLVABLE` semantics unchanged. M7-B recovery `target=T -> pending` remains correct. A state-satisfaction producer is **NOT an M8 terminal execution observation** and must not create a recovery classification.

Add a separate candidate **pure M8-B validation** for **closure-caused progression blocker disposition**, conceptually `validatePublicationStateClosureBlockerDisposition`, with a closed and explicitly typed proposal:

```ts
interface PublicationStateClosureBlockerDispositionV1 {
  readonly schema: "gate-a-publication-state-closure-blocker-disposition.v1";
  readonly publicationIntentId: PublicationIntentId;
  readonly closureCandidate: ArtifactRef;
  readonly blockerIdsToDispose: readonly BlockerId[];
  readonly basis: "publication-residual-effect-risk-closed";
}
```

M8-B MUST validate the complete currently projected blocker/OAR set and each proposed blockerId. Only an **outstanding, exact recovery-causal** blocker tied to an E in K, the same I/W/O and its exact retained causal recovery fact can be selected, for the explicit causes:
- `pending-policy-exhausted`;
- `executor-domain-indeterminacy` on a lawfully classified M8 `UNRESOLVABLE`;
- `no-recovery-capability` ONLY where a separately valid executor-specific Arm/recovery contract actually permits it (NOT the currently selected M7-B non-null-capability profile).

The resulting set is ALL AND ONLY the outstanding eligible recovery-causal blocker IDs in the complete verified relevant blocker set, ordered deterministically by E attemptOrdinal then BlockerId. The plan cannot choose an arbitrary subset, re-dispose previously operator-disposed blockers, dispose producer-occurrence/semantic/unrelated blockers, dispose a blocker attached to a different intent, or use a plain statement `R=T` as a disposition basis. Any conflicting blocker cause that is NOT eligible remains outstanding; if it makes a valid new confirmation impossible, the entire closure proposal is rejected rather than hiding the conflict.

**Meaning of new disposition:** `historical recovery cause remains true, but its need to block progression of I has been positively superseded by a separately admitted I-scoped residual-effect closure`. It is NOT `M8 recovery succeeded`, an Execution terminal result, a generic `ResolveBlockerV1`, an OperatorResolutionEnvelope or operator acknowledgement. M8-B does not inspect Git state or mutate M2; M2 revalidates the blocker set and co-admits the closure and exactly this typed disposition in ONE revision. The existing M8-B `PNE/PC/pending/domain-indeterminate` recovery-disposition matrix is not silently rewritten: this is a separately typed third *causal progression-closure* ground at M2, requiring explicit new NIB-S/M8-B/M2 authority.

A lawful terminal `UNRESOLVABLE` remains terminal in **historical recovery**. Its blocker can cease to be outstanding solely for this exact progression purpose without undoing, deleting, falsifying or reclassifying the terminal recovery resolution. Pre-existing operator supersessions remain intact. Every independent/outstanding blocker is preserved; a READY result still requires zero outstanding blockers.

## 7. ONE M2 atomic mutation and public confirmation provenance

Candidate new closed-union member: `AdmitPublicationStateSatisfactionV1`, **only** through M2's existing fenced `CommitAuthoritativeMutationRequest` envelope, with a separate trusted runtime producer-provenance capability as required in §5. Its immutable M0-canonical payload references the exact I/W/O/C/qualification, `PublicationProgressionClosureRefV1`, `QualifiedRemoteRefObservationV1`, full historical effect projection, positive residual effect theorem evidence, M8-B blocker-disposition proposal, deterministic confirmation/published view and satisfaction disposition.

On a SINGLE M2 transaction at exact expected `r` and ownership `g`, before mutating, require:
1. Run exists, is nonterminal and not semantically prohibited; exact current projected candidate C, qualification, I/W/O/R/P/T are compatible and O is outstanding/undisposed; P≺T.
2. No already-admitted closure, publication confirmation, obligation disposition or conflicting admitted publication-result basis for I.
3. Live producer-admission capability is genuine, current, single-use and bound exactly to the accepted #91 witness, successful actual after-context I/O and effective accepted producer/reader/target/consistency contract.
4. The complete M2 historical projection K is reconstructed at the currently committed r/g and is exactly the one from the trust-bound context; no new Arm, result admission, recovery, operator supersession, WorkItem/intent change or blocker change has escaped the proposed proof.
5. Every still-potentially-effectful E in K satisfies the qualified bounded `CAS(R,P,T)`-only/effect-scope proof; every safe E has exact independent positive safe disposition; any known direct terminal result retains its own original lane/priority and is not relabeled unknown; all old unsafe same-ref intents fail closed.
6. The admitted target T's full commit/tree/material representation, exact remote occurrence, monotonicity/environmental profile, and M7-B positive observation/closure are intact and valid. External condition not established => DO NOT commit; do not silently create a blocking status from mere absent proof.
7. All recovery blockers disposed are exactly the fresh M8-B-caused subset authorized in §6; no other outstanding blocker is falsified or silently removed. Conflicting blocks reject the closure; unrelated blocks remain and can independently prevent READY.
8. The public confirmation/provenance and publication obligation's EXACT single satisfied disposition validate against the same I/T/C and the admitted closure.

Atomically append in ONE new StateRevision:
- unique accepted `PublicationProgressionClosureRefV1` and its complete immutable provenance basis;
- exactly one `PublicationConfirmationRef` with unchanged `deriveId("publication-confirmation.v1", publicationIntentId)`;
- exact `PublishedRepositoryViewRef` bound to the unchanged C/T/materialization identity (the immutable view itself must be positively materialized/verified through M7-A before admission);
- exactly one `ObligationDispositionRef.kind="satisfied"` for O with the exact state-closure/observation/material proof basis;
- exactly the authorized new closed-causal blocker dispositions, and no others;
- exactly one versioned/publicly reconstructible `PublicationConfirmationAdmissionBasis` discriminant `post-arm-state-satisfaction` binding the closureRef and NO captured Execution result.

The confirmed admission source must be deterministically one of **three disjoint meanings**: `executed-publication` (retains direct or genuinely proven recovered source), `already-current` (original zero-E pre-Arm path), or `post-arm-state-satisfaction` (this I-scoped risk-closed path). Do NOT overwrite existing v1 `PublicationConfirmationRef` identity, infer source from equality, or pretend the current `PublicationObservationQualificationRequest` two-branch union already accepts the third branch. The owning NIB-S/M0/M2/M7-B must select compatible versioned public schema/provenance and update invariant I36 (which presently also conflicts with accepted already-current), before any implementer uses it.

If ANY guard fails, commit NOTHING. If the first closure commits while another exact direct-result mutation races, the later progression-bearing mutation must be rejected without a new StateRevision. If the direct terminal M2 admission commits first and carries the normal actionable applied/recovered qualification, the state candidate must not steal or rewrite that lane. An exact positive `PublicationNonApplicationRef` for E2 in a mixed E1-unknown history is preserved and may coexist as a safe historical fact; it must not be consumed as fake `PROVEN-NOT-EXECUTED(E1)`.

After successful closure, all included historically unknown E remain historical and epistemically unknown; they are excluded from **active progression-recovery requirements for this same I only** by the new I-scoped closure, not by a synthetic outcome or operator successor. An authorized-but-unarmed E2 remains historical; O's atomic satisfied disposition makes its future Arm invalid under GI-74/M2 §9. Snapshot reconstructs this third exclusion explicitly. No M8-A further recovery classification is needed for the closed purpose.

M6 still performs its required bound post-publication validation. M2 may admit terminal `GATE-A-READY` only after that positive validation and zero remaining blockers/obligations; ADR-057 forbids asserting current R=T at that later instant. No StateRevision is possible after READY.

## 8. Precise M1 routing and bounded automatic probes

Retain M1 resume order: acquire M2 write ownership; first validate/admit any *explicitly supplied* valid operator-resolution input through current M8-B/M2 rules; reload current history. Never silently discard an explicitly supplied resolution because a newer observation might make it unnecessary. That resolution may have superseded E1 and authorized E2 but not armed it.

For each current applicable I, **before any new publication E2 Arm**, and after an in-session publication `AdmitExecutionUncertaintyV1` commits, M1 enters a **publication-state progression proof gate** backed by ONE coherent M2 read and (if eligible) ONE qualified read-only #91 producer invocation. On restart or `resume-reconciliation`, the gate is evaluated even if `unresolvedExecutions=[]` (e.g. historical E1 operator-superseded or terminal M8 `UNRESOLVABLE` with blocker).

Routing:
```text
reload exact M2 current I/W/O and complete historical K
if ordinary known direct applied/recovered outcome is admissible:
    use original direct/recovery qualification path first; do not relabel
else if exact candidate state-closure scope applies:
    obtain one live context and qualified READ-ONLY observation
    if positive R=T AND all complete residual-effect proofs positive:
        M8-B pure blocker-disposition validation
        M2 ONE atomic state-closure/confirmation/O/blocker commit
        reload; continue with existing bound M6 postpublication validation
    if NOT_ESTABLISHED:
        preserve history and enter existing M8 recovery barrier
    if invalid source/contradictory proof:
        fail integrity/dependency; never convert to ordinary pending
else:
    enter existing lawful M8/recovery/operator path
```

If one finite M8 episode ends pending and no closure has already been admitted, **one final qualified state-only probe** MAY be required before admitting the pending-exhaustion OAR/blocker; if it positively closes I, skip making that blocker authoritative; otherwise commit the exact normal pending blocker and return OAR. A pre-existing pending blocker from an earlier episode may instead be disposed by a positive closure in a later session. This is explicitly a read-only progression check and never an M8 terminal outcome. This proposal selects at most **one pre-M8 and one post-M8 state probe per I per top-level invocation**, with no unbounded automatic retry after `NOT_ESTABLISHED` or stale admission. Repeated separately requested resumes can re-observe (as already allowed by current M8); no global automatic liveness/completion or lifetime polling budget is promised.

A transient T observed only in an intermediate M8 pending poll but not in a separately qualified #91 state-proof occurrence MAY still lead to a blocker; this is an explicit first-version **liveness limitation**, not a safety proof. M8's process-local trace, content-addressed observation ArtifactRef, or final pending witness is not silently promoted into a #91 actual-read admission; future shared-read optimization would need an independent approved producer/provenance contract.

**Required ratified invariant change:** existing NIB-S GI-54 and GI-56/M1 recovery-before-progression ordering must expressly allow this independent positively proved I-scoped closure to terminate the *need* for historical recovery as a progression prerequisite, without changing M8's exclusive classifier authority (GI-57/GI-58). The currently active NIB-S/M1 do NOT yet authorize the bypass; it is prohibited until accepted versioned synchronization.

## 9. Future publication intents and replacement safety

The new closure must not be limited to making the first T publication confirmable while creating a later dead end on a legitimate post-publication M6 failure/repair.

For a prospective later intent `I2` on the SAME verified authoritative R, the old intent `I1` may be positively safe to replace if every old Armed E is covered by: (a) exact `PROVEN-NOT-EXECUTED`, or (b) exact direct `PublicationNonApplicationRef`, or (c) an **already-admitted, still-qualified I1-scoped progression closure** whose effect theorem makes that E's OLD expected-old mutation forever unable to affect R in the declared future interval. The new prepublication observation/predecessor/qualification requirements for I2 remain independent; the old closure alone does not authorize another ref mutation or qualify I2's candidate.

This is a deliberate proposed extension of GI-75/GI-82 and M2 I50/I62, NOT something those currently accepted invariants already permit. A historical closure cannot validate any new candidate, guarantee the current remote equals the earlier T, rescue a broken external monotonicity assumption or manufacture a new publication Execution. If the effect theorem does not remain applicable to R/I2, replacement MUST fail closed.

The existing applied-direct publication case is governed by its original published/requalification/repair semantics and is not automatically reclassified by this extension.

## 10. Concurrent and late direct outcomes; audit boundary

* Before the proof gate, M1 must process an already-authoritative eligible direct terminal result via the original exact direct path. `not-applied` remains a real nonapplication fact, not a synthetic "unknown"; only a distinct still-unknown E in the same W may justify the special lane.
* Two racing potential M2 mutations are serialized by current revision/owner; the first lawfully admitted version wins under the respective existing semantics. State closure cannot be admitted over a presently admitted conflicting direct applied result; direct admission after accepted closure cannot alter progression or create a second confirmation.
* A direct external response might physically arrive **after** its E has been progression-superseded or I has been closed. No after-the-fact state reconciliation is allowed to assert that this raw receipt was admitted earlier. GI-71 and post-READY mutation freeze continue to prohibit its progression-bearing admission.
* The historically known facts of M2 must not be falsified to make a later receipt appear known. Where already accepted independent audit/evidence authority permits, seal such exact late material as non-progression evidence without changing historical E classification or terminal READY. **This first version does NOT claim a complete, indefinitely discoverable post-READY late-response audit channel**: the existing GateARun StateRevision is frozen after READY and the proposal does not silently create a new global store/authority. If a mandatory complete post-READY receipt-audit requirement is separately established, route it to an explicit new factual audit contract rather than abusing M2 publication/Execution terminal status. This residual assurance limitation must be surfaced during hostile review, not concealed as "fully reconciled outcome truth".

## 11. Crash / replay / idempotence table

* Crash before context read: no positive observation, no closure.
* Crash after M2 read but before Git I/O, or during I/O: no closure; resume obtains fresh M2 context and actual qualified read; no CAS replay.
* Crash after qualified Git I/O or sealing the witness but BEFORE M2 admission: unadmitted artifacts have no progression authority; runtime-only producer capability vanishes; resume MUST make a fresh context/read even if r/value bytes happen to be unchanged.
* Crash/interrupt during M2 mutation: all closure, public confirmation basis, obligation satisfaction and authorized blocker dispositions are committed in one new StateRevision or NONE; full post-commit snapshot invariants are checked before success.
* Crash after confirmation but before M6: reconstruct exactly the immutable confirmed T view and run M6, without ref write.
* Crash after positive M6 validation but before READY: re-derive from M2 admitted evidence and admit READY at most once.
* Crash after READY: no campaign-state mutation. Historical E truth is not retroactively invented.
* Replay/duplicate first closure proposal: no new authorized revision if I already closed; no reservation from an unadmitted artifact; same logical ID with different authoritative bytes is an integrity conflict.
* New Arm E2 after the contextual Git read: M2 revision changed, reject stale closure; if closure committed first, O satisfaction makes E2 Arm illegal.
* New operator supersession/ownership transfer: r or g changes, reject stale context; M1 may later get a new read under new authority. Never erase operator history.

## 12. Explicit invariant/interface synchronization required BEFORE implementation

No active source is changed by this Issue comment. A later accepted construction change must reconcile:

* **NIB-S** GI-54, GI-56, GI-57, GI-58, GI-65, GI-70/71, GI-74/75, GI-79/80, GI-82/83, §8.5 W satisfaction, §29–31 confirmation/readiness, and the exact public request/result/provenance union.
* **M2 mutation** new closed-union member; read-only complete history projection; exact r/g and trusted producer admission; unique closure fact, confirmation/O/materialization/blocker atomic commit; direct precedence; operator and next-intent guards; no new Arm after satisfied O.
* **M2 snapshot/integrity** the entire reconstruction path for source provenance, I36 (already conflicting with pre-Arm already-current), I19/I42–I45, I50/I52/I56–I59/I62, active unresolved projection and terminal historical UNRESOLVABLE/nonapplication facts.

* **M7-B/M0** positive state producer and residual-effect witness, exact qualified occurrence consumed from #91 (not bare target-value bytes), typed canonical schemas, no recovered publication outcome fabrication, and the known `missing/X -> unknown` positive exhaustion defect separately confronted.
* **M1/M6** deterministic trigger/preemption/order, GI-54 exception, M6 immutable T validation and crash recovery; stale NIB consumer version pins reconciled under #90.
* **#88/#89/#91** actual authority/writer/reader binding, independent pre-Arm authorization, correctly enforced protected CAS, real remote read receipt/consistency and trust, full conformance. No fabricated qualified dependency.

A change to an accepted invariant must be explicitly accepted at its correct owning authority and versioned. A coding agent may never silently pick which contradictory assertion to implement. No new TURNLOCK runtime Product Intent, `TL-INV`, protocol P, semantic subject S, generic SCOPE IR, or producer-specific runtime implementation is introduced by this controller proposal.

## 13. Hostile-review counterexample matrix (NOT a claim of passing tests)

Required later independent attacks against the **EXACT v0.3.0 bytes and source-pinned authorities**, including BOTH architecture and M2/M8/ADR/ARM/GitDC packets:

H01 E itself published T and response lost; H02 a different eligible writer published exact T and E did not. No E truth derived.  
H03 old guarded CAS still in flight after t_obs; H04 old E has alternate ref write/hidden retry or effect not covered by scope.

H06 E1 unknown, E2 directly known not-applied, exact PNA preserved, R=T from outside; mixed lane lawful only with positive E1 closure.  
H07 E only directly known not-applied, no unknown E; existing fresh I2 already-current route, no post-Arm already-current for old I.  
H08 direct applied/recovered truth already authoritative before candidate closure; no double admission or provenance relabel.  
H09 same-session lost response; H10 resume with pending blocker; H11 legal terminal UNRESOLVABLE with exact existing blocker; H12 invalid unsupported-historical-query indeterminacy cannot pass integrity.

H14 prior operator-disposed B not re-disposed; other independent producer/semantic blockers remain.  
H15 forged value/witness, copied hash, wrong target, unqualified consistency/reader/producer, or replayed live-capability fields; no admission.  
H16 E2 Arm/other M2 commit after read; H17 ownership g changes while StateRevision r does not; both reject candidate.  
H18 two real reads returning identical value bytes but different actual I/O receipts; H19 crash at every read/commit boundary and no receipt reuse after crash.  
H20 R=T at t_obs then T→V before M2/READY; historical T claim remains exact, present-time V readiness NOT asserted.  
H21 admin protection bypass or qualified assumption absent, ref rewritten to P and old CAS could revive: fail/unsupported, not a claimed theorem.  
H22 direct result arrives after operator supersession, after closure, after READY; no post-hoc authoritative progression; audit limitation explicit.  
H23 one O has a single satisfied disposition/confirmation/closure across duplicate or conflicting witnesses.  
H24 M6 post-publication validation fails, later safe I2/candidate repair needed; no unsafe revival or misattribution of old E.  
H25 previous intent on same R remains genuinely potentially-effectful; cannot skip older history by looking only at current W.  
H26 no Armed E but an authorized-unarmed E exists and third party published T; use legal new I2 path, not v0.3 special lane.  
H27 no positive real read or incomplete protected-CAS conformance: closure NOT_ESTABLISHED.  
H28 corrupted historical Arm, invalid M8 `UNRESOLVABLE`, stale state snapshot, violated public I36 or inconsistent blocker identity: integrity failure.  
H29 repeated explicit resumes after NOT_ESTABLISHED: no same-invocation unbounded automatic loop; no universal liveness assertion.  
H30 future `I2` replaces already-closed `I1` under the exact residual effect proof; no independent new CAS or qualification inferred.

Every material counterexample survives until source-confronted adjudication; majority votes and validated citations alone do not prove correctness. The previous Codex v0.2.0 raw reviews were globally citation-invalid, with supplemental 41/45 per-finding mechanical citation anchors; Mistral responses were incomplete. They are useful **unadjudicated attack hypotheses**, NOT a completed two-provider review of this new subject.

## 14. v0.2.0 reviewer-findings disposition categories (architect hypothesis, NOT accepted)

* **Upstream READY/time/actor meaning:** architecture A-F001/A-F020, authority B-F001/B-F011 now have new ACCEPTED ADR-057 authority; H1/H2 separation remains mandatory.
* **True previously absent construction transitions:** A-F002–F005, A-F007–F013, A-F021–F024, B-F002–F008, B-F016–F019 require the expressly scoped new NIB-S/M0/M1/M2/M7-B/M8-B/versioned reconstruction/late-audit treatment above. No active NIB is claimed synchronized yet.
* **Git read/protected transport/monotonicity dependencies:** A-F016–F019 and B-F008–F010 remain actual #88/#91 conformance blockers; the new producer schema is a proposal, not qualified evidence.
* **Finite episode and transient observation liveness:** A-F014/A-F015, B-F014/B-F015 are explicit bounded v1 limitations, not demonstrated failures of the guarded safety theorem. No claim of finite total work across unbounded explicit resumes.
* **Review-source omissions:** architecture A-F025 is a packet-corpus limitation, not evidence that proto-ring ARM semantics are false; authority B-F020 (claimed missing Governance Binding Registry pin) is refuted by the active `docs/repository-governance/turnlock-rust-governance-bindings.md` entry at original pinned SHA.
* **Direct not-applied scenario:** B-F012 is not a universal dead end because NIB-S §30 already supports lawful fresh I2 on valid PNA; the mixed E1-unknown/E2-PNA case needs and now receives its own explicit treatment rather than an erroneous blanket exclusion.
* **Cross-module version drift:** architecture A-F006, authority B-F006 and other stale dependency pins remain a real #90 issue, not evidence of achieved conformance.
* **Late direct evidence:** A-F022 and B-F019 identify a real audit/discoverability limitation, explicitly exposed in §10. No bogus complete audit guarantee is made.

These labels are an architect's source-informed working adjudication and must NOT mutate raw reviewer findings, accept a NIB, or count as independent qualified hostile review.

## 15. Current gate result / strict non-goals

**Architectural candidate v0.3.0 is now precisely defined for independent challenge.** The first-version state-satisfaction safety proposition is conditional on independently qualified Git DC/provider consistency and environmental monotonicity, not established by local experiments or comment text. Exact construction schemas and atomic transition must be version-ratified before an implementation agent executes any part of it.

Required order: (1) independent source-pinned hostile counterexample review of this candidate and reconciliation of surviving findings; (2) explicit architect/governance ratification at the owning controller construction layer; (3) coordinated NIB-S/M0/M1/M2/M6/M7-B/M8-B/persistence/schema reconciliation and #90 pins, treating inconsistent old statements as blockers; (4) separately qualify #88/#89/#91 external I/O/authority/ref/CAS; (5) NIB-T #32, complete construction review #33 and relevant formal model/conformance evidence. # Issue #87 — Architect's corrected publication-state satisfaction adjudication v0.3.1

**Decision subject:** `GA-PUBLICATION-STATE-SATISFACTION-ADJUDICATION-v0.3.1`.  
**Status:** `PROPOSED / ARCHITECT-SELECTED / NOT RATIFIED / INDEPENDENT HOSTILE REVIEW REQUIRED`. No accepted NIB/ADR/mutation or external Git conformance is created by this comment.  
**Pinned authority baseline:** `fanilosendrison/turnlock-rust@ec52ebc62d4d9584e16c7e6bbb26ccb4f466135d`.  
**Accepted upstream:** ADR-057, `docs/adr/adr-057-define-gate-a-runner-ready-as-observation-bound-publication.md` (blob `f03c37ce05e370e27d25e83d95192e27b9872f08`).  
**External proof candidate (NOT qualified):** #91 [`GA-QUALIFIED-REMOTE-REF-OBSERVATION-v0.2.0`](https://github.com/fanilosendrison/turnlock-rust/issues/91#issuecomment-6267500720).  
**Replaces for proposed construction:** [#87 v0.3.0](https://github.com/fanilosendrison/turnlock-rust/issues/87#issuecomment-6267948647); that exact historical text remains immutable.  
**Architect-side hostile assessment:** 2026-10-19, not a separately executed independent Codex/Mistral review or a TLC run. The v0.3.0 H01–H30 matrix was manually confronted with exact authoritative M2/M7/M8/NIB-S contracts; findings and limitations are tracked below.  
**Dependency owners:** #87 progression closure; #88 actual authority/target/principal; #89 distinct pre-Arm freshness; #90 versioned M0/M1/M2/M6/M7/M8 synchronization; #91 full Git DC and real I/O; #32 NIB-T; #33 whole construction review. No Issue state/Project/repository ref is changed here.

## 1. Corrected selection and non-negotiable proposition

For one EXACT current authorized `PublicationIntent I`, publication WorkItem `W(I)`, its SOLE source publication obligation `O(I)`, exact qualified candidate C, authoritative protected Git ref R, and strict fast-forward transition P≺T:

```text
ActualStateWitness(R=T at qualified t_obs)
AND AllRelevantHistoricalExecutionEffectsClosedForI
AND M2CurrentStateStillMatchesCheckedHistory
AND LawfulBlockerDisposition
  => candidate for ATOMIC I-scoped publication-obligation satisfaction

does NOT imply:
  PROVEN-COMPLETED(E)
  PROVEN-NOT-EXECUTED(E)
  new Execution
  generic WorkItemSatisfied
  pre-Arm already-current
  unrestricted follow-on PublicationIntent I2
  perpetual current R=T
  current-repository Formal Gate A READY
```

Only M2 can accept a durable progression authority transition; M7-B/Git DC owns qualified Git facts, M8 owns historical E recovery classifications and pure blocker-causality validation, M6 validates immutable published T. This is controller construction semantics only, NOT TURNLOCK runtime product semantics and no new `TL-INV`.

**Delta from v0.3.0 F-01:** the state closure terminates the exact SAME I for its already-authorized publication objective; its confirmation expressly **does not** authorize a successor I2 in this GateARun. Current post-publication M6 failure remains the existing OAR/blocked route. Do not extend old `replacement-safe(E)` by silently treating a confirmed I as supersedable.

## 2. Closed one-intent eligibility domain and complete history

The first state-closure lane applies iff all are positively shown:

1. Exact I is latest applicable/current projected I for run, candidate C and accepted qualification Qc; R matches immutable GateARun target, `P != T`, exact commit-and-tree authority T, and `P` is positively proven strict ancestor of T. No `P==T` post-Arm shortcut.
2. Exactly one co-admitted publication O and W exist for I. O remains outstanding, no prior confirmation/closure, run not READY or semantically terminal. A previous later/unsafe same-ref intent or stale candidate cannot be masked by closure.
3. One coherent read-only M2 projection of historical `(run,r,g,I,W,O,C,Qc,R,P,T)` includes ALL W historical Executions, Arms, operation/recovery bindings, direct and recovered terminal outcomes, nonapplication facts, pending observations, progression supersessions, blocker/OAR disposition history, and prior-intent chain. Enumerate historical attempts by exact ordinal and IDs. **Never use `unresolvedExecutions` as the exhaustive risk set**: E1 may be operator-superseded or valid terminal `UNRESOLVABLE` yet still historically capable of an old effect.
4. At least one Armed E has an epistemically UNKNOWN relevant publication effect. Another E in the SAME W may have an exact prior direct `not-applied` plus valid authoritative `PublicationNonApplicationRef`; this remains a separate valid safe fact and does NOT disqualify closure when another E is unknown. Ordinary known applied/other conflicting terminal lanes cannot be relabeled unknown or overridden.
5. Every unknown Armed E is bound through exact immutable Arm/dispatch/recovery/operation history to the same effect scope: the only potentially remaining mutation of authoritative R is ONE exact atomic `CAS(R,P,T)`. No duplicate transport write, hidden retry, alternate ref, fallback, force-like bypass or other effect that could invalidate the I publication assertion. Non-effectful Armed E require their own positive `PROVEN-NOT-EXECUTED` or lawful direct PNA fact. An authorized-but-unarmed E remains included in the full history, and future Arm is fenced when O is atomically satisfied.
6. A qualified actual post-context read of authoritative R proves exact `R(t_obs)=T`, with provider identity and consistency assumptions positively qualified. Under applicable external monotonic ordinary-writer protection for the full relevant future-effect interval in the selected threat model, R can never again have P as tip after t_obs. Consequently each covered old `CAS(R,P,T)` can no longer modify R. This is an effect-safety proof ONLY; the historical executor/actor remains unknown.

The last theorem requires #88/#91 positive real transport/ref/principal/CAS and environmental conformance, currently absent. One ruleset GET, Git command exit code, observation value hash or unauthenticated arbitrary JSON cannot prove it. A protection administrator bypass or provider compromise is outside the declared proto-ring ARM threat model; no claim of resisting such behavior is made. Missing required qualification = `NOT_ESTABLISHED`, not success or inferred E outcome.

Historical M8 `UNRESOLVABLE` is eligible for the risk set ONLY if it was **originally legally admitted**, under positive required M8/executor-domain evidence and the then-applicable contract. The current M7-B `missing/X -> unknown` inference from lack of historical-operation-query capability is independently suspect; an integrity-invalid historical classification is NOT repaired by a new T observation.

## 3. Exactly ONE new I-scoped progression fact, NOT E outcome or W success

Proposed immutable fact (illustrative versioned contract requiring acceptance at NIB-S/M0/M2):

```ts
interface PublicationProgressionClosureRefV1 {
  readonly schema: "gate-a-publication-progression-closure.v1";
  readonly closureId: string;
  readonly runId: GateARunId;
  readonly publicationIntentId: PublicationIntentId;
  readonly publicationWorkItemId: WorkItemId;
  readonly publicationObligationId: ObligationId;
  readonly candidateId: CandidateRevisionId;
  readonly qualificationId: GateAQualificationId;
  readonly transition: AuthorizedGitTransitionRef; // exact R,P,T
  readonly qualifiedObservation: ArtifactRef;     // #91 candidate witness
  readonly effectHistoryProjection: ArtifactRef;  // full E history at r/g
  readonly residualEffectProof: ArtifactRef;      // all old E guards + ARM scope
}
```

Logical closure identity `deriveId("publication-progression-closure.v1", publicationIntentId)` is unique per I. No unadmitted candidate artifact reserves identity. One successful M2 mutation owns the first authoritative closure; a duplicate after commit makes NO new StateRevision, and different bytes under the same admitted logical identity are incompatible. The evidence projection/digest MUST be recomputed from exact M2 authoritative history, not trusted as client-provided coverage.

The publication WorkItem W remains an immutable attributable unit. NIB-S §8.5 still requires its own qualified result class to assert `WorkItemSatisfied`. We do not invent one. Once its unique source obligation O is satisfied, W is INERT with no lawful new authorization/Arm, while its existing E/Arm and historical outcomes remain intact. Satisfaction of I is NOT historical success of W's individual Executions.

## 4. Qualified occurrence and no post-Arm durable Q

Consume [#91 exact candidate witness](https://github.com/fanilosendrison/turnlock-rust/issues/91#issuecomment-6267500720) with existing target observation value, exact M2 snapshot `(r,g,I,W,O)`, verified qualified Git read I/O transcript and a *protected, nonserializable, single-use runtime first-admission capability* produced only by the trusted M2→M7-B→DC causal call chain. Bare `ArtifactRef` equality cannot prove remote I/O, execution order or trusted producer origin.

No additional #87 M2 StateRevision is created to begin an observation. The *first* M2 admission requires current live capability and exact response/receipt/profiles. Its one authoritative mutation records in append-only history:
- positive immutable witness and its qualification/transport/target/reader/consistency refs;
- exact underlying producer invocation identity plus evidence context and M2 state-revision/ownership generation;
- the **fact of M2's successful trusted producer-origin check** as part of the authoritative mutation provenance/closure-admission basis;
- the exact single transition whose admission consumed that live check.

**After crash, M2 does not reconstruct the private runtime capability or independently infer that GitHub was contacted from JSON.** It validates that a trusted admission was durably recorded by its fenced append-only mutation, plus exact intact receipts/bindings/qualification identity. Thus replay verification relies explicitly on historical M2 write authority and the selected trusted I/O TCB, not on fake independent remote attestation.

A sealed but UNADMITTED observation is not progression authority. If crash precedes the M2 closure commit, any ephemeral capability is lost; resume must obtain a fresh M2 contextual read and perform a NEW qualified READ-ONLY remote observation even if r, T and value hashes happen to be identical. No CAS replay, no durable `Q` in #87, no time-based freshness heuristic. #89's pre-Arm Q question remains separate and OPEN.

**Race/capability rule:** a failed or stale first admission consumes/invalidates the live capability; no second submission can label the old I/O as a new occurrence. A new independent observation may be performed if an eligible new M1 invocation/state revision permits. The current public `CommitAuthoritativeMutationRequest` supplies only `AuthoritativeMutationRef`; the versioned M2/M7 composition must add a protected internal producer-admission route (not another user-serializable proof field) before implementation. #90 owns exact API realization.

## 5. M8-B: progression blocker supersession preserves historical recovery truth

M8-A's `pending`, `PROVEN-COMPLETED`, `PROVEN-NOT-EXECUTED` and lawfully `UNRESOLVABLE` remain unchanged. A state closure is **not** a second historical E classifier or recovered captured publication result.

Select a distinct pure M8-B `PublicationStateClosureBlockerDispositionV1` proposal with exact I, W, O, closure evidence, the exact ordered set of blockerIds, and basis `publication-residual-effect-risk-closed`. M8-B validates the full retained OAR/blocker catalog and computes ALL AND ONLY outstanding recovery-causal blockers for Executions in the closed K and this exact I/W/O whose sole current obstruction to this I's progression is the proven residual-effect uncertainty. Valid causes:
- `pending-policy-exhausted`;
- `executor-domain-indeterminacy` from an **originally valid** M8 `UNRESOLVABLE`;
- `no-recovery-capability` only if the later accepted executor profile permits lawful Arm with null capability — current M7-B conditional publication requires non-null recovery capability and cannot use this branch.

No historical blocker is deleted, rewritten, re-disposed or alleged to have had a false historical cause. No producer-occurrence, semantic, different-intent or unrelated operational blocker is disposed. No operator-authored resolution, `ExecutionProgressionSupersessionRef` with successor E, generic `ResolveBlocker` or fabricated M8 terminal result is created.

M2 must revalidate M8-B's proposal and co-admit EXACT chosen eligible dispositions with I's closure in one revision; M8-B does not mutate M2 or interpret Git. This would explicitly amend existing M2 §16 and M8-B §10 only after ratification; it is NOT yet a legal disposition under the old closed matrix. Prior operator-disposed E1 blocker remains historical; E1 remains in K if its residual effect is still relevant.

A valid terminal M8 `UNRESOLVABLE` remains true even after its blocker is disposed for the new progression reason. M2 must distinguish **historical recovery truth** from **currently required active recovery/progression obligation**, and snapshot/integrity must reconstruct the distinction, including prior E1 supersession, without ever making that E reappear as actionable unresolved work.

## 6. F-03 correction: closure may coexist with INDEPENDENT blockers, but cannot dispatch through them

An I-specific closure is **positive factual admission**, not an authorization for arbitrary ordinary campaign progression. If another outstanding operational blocker exists and is unrelated to I's now-neutralized residual effect:
1. Validate its original immutable identity, cause/OAR and currentness.
2. Preserve it unchanged and outstanding. Do NOT include it in M8-B's closure-causal disposition set.
3. M2 MAY admit I's exact complete qualified state closure/confirmation/obligation satisfaction **despite that unrelated operational blocker**, via a narrowly versioned special admission rule, provided the blocker does not logically contradict I/C/qualification/current authority and the run is not semantically terminal.
4. M1 MUST reload authoritative state immediately after closure. If ANY other operational blocker remains, M1 MUST return the existing `OPERATOR-ACTION-REQUIRED` projection with full blocker/OAR set and MUST NOT run M6 or any other ordinary effectful/normal progression phase.
5. Only when all remaining blockers have later been resolved through their OWN existing lawful authority may M1 resume the already-confirmed I's pending M6 validation. It must NOT repeat publication, re-admit confirmation or invent I2.

The new M2 special admission is NOT a generic "ignore blockers" rule: M2's normal Authorize/Arm and other effectful operations remain blocked. Semantic progression terminality still forbids the new closure as currently selected; a competing semantic blocker is not bypassed. If an outstanding blocker semantically contradicts confirmation rather than being independent, reject the closure and preserve the blocker. In particular, a genuinely failed known-domain publication observation/qualification cannot be silently overwritten with an I state closure.

This fixes v0.3.0's ambiguous "commit closure then continue M6" ordering, while allowing independent, already-established facts to be retained without erasing unrelated blocker provenance.

## 7. F-02 correction: post-confirmation crash and ephemeral PublishedRepositoryViewRef.repositoryPath

NIB-S currently represents `PublishedRepositoryViewRef.repositoryPath` as an **operational location only**, never immutable repository identity. M7-A `materialize_projected_successor` can materialize an authorized exact retained projection and verify the exact commit/tree authority; the current M7-B §28 says resume after confirmation must use authoritative confirmation/published view. Those statements are **NOT** a contract that the original process-local path survives a crash.

Select exact versioned **read-only rematerialization/rebinding** before M6 when the original path is missing, stale or is in another session:

```text
M2 load exact already admitted I/C/qualification/confirmation/T
  + exact already-admitted published-view authority descriptor/projection refs
  + original retained RepositoryInspectionRef / sealed candidate basis
M7-A materialize_projected_successor from those exact retained immutable inputs
  -> NEW isolated runtime repositoryPath
  -> positive exact commit and tree identity == T, correct projection/candidate
M7-B derive a runtime PublishedRepositoryViewRef for M6
  -> same confirmation ID / candidate / target / T / materialization
     evidence identity and exact validated authority
  -> operational repositoryPath MAY differ
M6 validate exact isolated runtime view and sealed object/material basis
M2 admit passing validation only against SAME durable identity-bound
   publication confirmation + view authority; never by mutable path equality
```

The current v1 `PublishedRepositoryViewRef` type includes `repositoryPath`. Its **authority-bearing projection and runtime binding MUST be separated in an accepted versioned NIB-S/M0/M7/M6/M2 contract** before use: do NOT silently compare a stale serialized path, re-use an unverified old checkout, persist a new "second confirmation" merely because a path changed, or hand-edit old authoritative bytes to replace the path. The new path is a newly verified operational realization of the **same exact immutable T**, not another source of Git authority. If M7-A cannot reconstruct T from the retained exact sealed material in the accepted dependency support profile, fail closed as dependency/integrity failure; never re-publish or accept a different commit/tree.

The rematerialization is read-only with respect to remote authoritative ref R (local scratch materialization is permitted); it does NOT perform `CAS(P,T)`, repeat an uncertain E, obtain a new `PublicationConfirmationRef`, or turn the ref's current value V back to T. ADR-057 permits `R` to have advanced `T→V` when M6 validates immutable T. A failed M6 validation still follows its **existing** OAR rule (§8), never a newly improvised repair.

The same recovery is required when an unrelated blocker postponed M6 and the old operational path became stale before the blocker was lawfully resolved.

## 8. F-01 correction: NO I2 replacement after confirmed I1 and failed M6

Remove v0.3.0 §9's inferred "closed I1 enables subsequent same-run I2" transition.

**Current exact authority:**
- M2 `EstablishPublicationIntentV1` §5.13.4 (Case C) requires **NO** prior `PublicationConfirmationRef` and old E positive replacement safety to admit different I2 for same current candidate/qualification.
- `ObligationDispositionRef` cannot be both satisfied and later superseded: each obligation has one terminal disposition. The new closure atomically SATISFIES O1.
- NIB-S/M1/M6 post-publication `passed=false` produces the exact mechanical-validation `post-publication-integrity` obligation/blocker, with `resolutionContracts=[]`, `OPERATOR-ACTION-REQUIRED` and NO normal same-run revalidation, republishing or new candidate repair on that basis.

Therefore the allowed progression is:

```text
I1 closure + confirmation + O1 satisfied
    -> immutable T view
    -> post-publication M6
        -> PASS: M2 GateAReady if zero other blockers
        -> FAIL: exact M6 failure obligation/OAR; no same-run I2

Future distinct GateARun:
    derive fresh current repository authority and independent new I
    under its own complete preflight/qualification rules;
    I1 closure is historical evidence, NOT its new publication authorization
```

Even if old E1's old `CAS(P,T)` is positively effect-inert after the valid T witness, that fact alone cannot remove an M6 failure blocker, re-open already-satisfied O1, or waive the no-prior-confirmation guard. A separately selected and accepted future post-publication repair policy would be required for any same-run I2. No such policy is selected here.

Prior **UNCONFIRMED** I1 intent replacement remains subject to existing GI-75/GI-82 and M2 I50/I62; this candidate does not broaden old `replacement-safe` meaning to make unsafe intent replacements legal.

## 9. F-04 correction: durable M2 admission provenance without resurrecting ephemeral capability

The transient protected producer-admission capability exists only as an **admission-time authority check** in the trusted execution chain. It is not required to survive a crash and cannot independently serve as a signed GitHub I/O attestation.

The successful immutable M2 mutation must store a versioned, reconstructible **admission basis** containing:
- exact historical observation `QualifiedRemoteRefObservationV1`, its original qualified actual-IO receipt, producer qualification/target/reader/provider consistency/effective authority bindings;
- exact run, owner generation g, base StateRevision r, intent I/W/O, effect-history projection/digest and residual-effect closure proof;
- a causally matched producer invocation ID and explicit fact that M2 **successfully enforced** the protected trusted-producer admission predicate at that original commit;
- exact closure identity, confirmation provenance discriminant `post-arm-state-satisfaction`, O satisfaction, and deterministic legal blocker dispositions committed in the SAME revision.

On restart M2 validates the exact retained mutation journal, its type/revision/generation bindings, producer qualification artifacts and immutable evidence closure. It does **not** re-run the old transient capability check, claim that historic I/O was independently cryptographically attested, or infer a different E historical outcome. The trust claim is relative to the accepted Git DC + M2 correct execution TCB at original admission. A forged old artifact without a legitimate original M2 journal is NEVER made authoritative.

The admitting API MUST prevent arbitrary callers from submitting JSON/ArtifactRefs and claiming the original private producer capability. The current public `CommitAuthoritativeMutationRequest` lacks that producer-origin control; #90 must provide the versioned protected internal route. This is an explicit construction blocker, not a detail that an implementation agent may choose to ignore.

The original call's completion result may be lost after commit: M1 reloads exact M2 authority; if I is already uniquely closed it neither generates a second closure nor replays the external effect. If the transaction never committed, after crash the old unadmitted witness is not usable; start a new M2 read and actual Git observation with a NEW private runtime capability. No separate durable Q for #87.

## 10. ONE atomic M2 closure/confirmation/obligation/blocker mutation

Candidate exact M2 closed-union member `AdmitPublicationStateSatisfactionV1` owns only this I-scoped route. The deterministic proposal contains the qualified state observation, full exact historical K, independently verified residual-effect scope/theorem, original producer admission basis, closureRef, matching confirmation/published T-view authority descriptor, exact M8-B pure causal blocker dispositions, and the fixed one-O satisfied basis.

M2 verifies inside ONE `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` fenced authoritative transaction:
1. Current run authority and same r,g as read context; exact I/W/O/C/qualification/R/P/T; strict P≺T; semantic progression nonterminal; current O outstanding; no prior confirmation/closure/disposition.
2. Exact qualified actual I/O in the accepted reader/target/consistency profile **after** this authoritative read context; correct live private protected first-admission capability; exact immutable evidence artifacts and producer qualification; no cross-context receipt replay.
3. ## 11. Exact M1 gate order, stale handling and bounded liveness

**M8-B:** separate pure I-causal recovery-blocker progression-disposition proposal; validate full OAR/cause bindings and exact blockers; never reclassify historic E or forge operator resolution. M8-A historical algorithm and finite six-poll episode unchanged.

M1 may not invent an I2 after failed bound M6 validation. Stale r/g = no external CAS replay.

**#88/#89/#90/#91:** still must accept/qualify effective target/principal, pre-Arm causality, exact chosen M2 private API, Git DC 23 primitives, real provider consistency and protected atomic expected-old mutation. No feature is GREEN without independent positive conformance.

## 14. v0.3.0 adversarial findings — disposition and new regressions

**F-05 (BLOCKING SEPARATE SOURCE CONTRADICTION):** `missing/X -> unknown` M7-B indeterminacy does not follow from absent historical query alone. An invalid preexisting UNRESOLVABLE is NOT made valid by this closure. Needs source-authority fix before use.

**F-08 (EXPLICIT BOUNDED LIVENESS):** T seen during ephemeral M8 pending polling may not be reusable as trusted state-closure I/O without #91 qualified occurrence; no indefinite polling claim.

**Decision subject:** `GA-PUBLICATION-STATE-SATISFACTION-ADJUDICATION-v0.3.2`.  
**Status:** `PROPOSED / ARCHITECT-SELECTED / NOT RATIFIED / NOT IMPLEMENTABLE UNTIL ALL SOURCE AND DC GATES CLOSE`. This is NOT an accepted ADR or NIB, executable M2 mutation, GitHub provider qualification, independent completed hostile review, TLC/model-check proof or GREEN permission.
